other_conditions: Total family income must be less than ₹10,000 per month in rural areas or ₹12,000 per month in urban areas
Family land holding must be less than 3.00 acres of wet land or 10.00 acres of dry land or 10.00 acres combined wet and dry land
Family must not own a four‑wheeler (excluding taxis, tractors, and autos)
No family member may be a government employee or pensioner
Monthly electricity consumption of the family dwelling unit must be less than 300 units
In municipal areas the family must own less than 750 sq ft of built‑up area
No family member should be an income‑tax payee
Only one pension is allowed per family except when the family has a disabled person with ≥80 % disability, a dialysis patient, severe mental retardation, or PLHIV on ART
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹2,250 for most categories, ₹3,000 for persons with disability, and ₹10,000 for CKDU/dialysis patients
